name: Clarice's Pendant
summary: In the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff, Clarice Foster keeps the pendant her former husband gave her. Yuriv’s devotion to the Light left her and their children behind.

sections.title: A Bitter Token
sections.body: Before the Third War consumed Lordaeron, Yuriv left Clarice Foster and their children to fight the undead. He believed the Holy Light came before all else. Yuriv died, and the Scourge he had set out to fight took his family. Now Clarice is Forsaken, and she sees the pendant he gave her as an insult. It reminds her that she and the children came second to his zeal and duty.

sections.title: Resting upon Yuriv's Tomb
sections.body: Clarice wants to sever her last ties to Yuriv and the life they shared. She sends an adventurer to lay the pendant on his grave at the Sepulcher. His neglected tomb lies beneath weeds and trash, and has been vandalized. When the pendant rests on the coffin’s sculpted hands, its gemstone grows dull. The last warmth of Clarice’s former life goes out.

aliases: who does the pendant belong to
faq.answer: Clarice Foster, a Forsaken woman in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff, owns the pendant. Her husband Yuriv gave it to her before he marched off to war.
Yuriv was Clarice’s husband while they were alive. He left her and their children to fight the rising undead in the name of the Holy Light. He died and lies in a neglected grave at the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why does Clarice want to get rid of the pendant?
faq.answer: Clarice resents Yuriv for putting his crusade and devotion to the Light before her and their children. He died, and Clarice was left behind and raised in undeath, the very fate he sought to prevent.

faq.q: What happens when the pendant is placed on Yuriv's grave?
faq.answer: Laying the pendant on Yuriv’s grave lets Clarice part with the keepsake and the painful attachment it carries.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you may know the bitterness of loved ones who left to fight crusades that failed to protect anyone. Many Forsaken share that loss.
As a paladin, you may find Clarice’s contempt for Yuriv’s crusade hard to hear. His holy zeal left a broken home behind.
